_doc: Song structure for analysis/measurement. Nominal bars at the nominal BPM; real songs drift, so sections are anchored to lyric lines (first_line) found by Whisper, not to these bar counts. A section whose first_line is null starts where the previous section's nominal length ends. For chorus-type sections the first bar is the stop/pickup bar and hook.word's stressed syllable should land on the downbeat of bar 2 of the section. expect = arrangement checks (advisory, measured from Demucs stems, never pass/fail gates).
